purpose: Fitted-sweep timings with the threaded genotype products forced on or off, by model columns

package_source.note: HEAD's _vb.py, before _GEMM_MIN_COLUMNS was removed; the probe overrides the thresholds at run time

design: VBEngine.fit, cross-fit shape (P folds, column p holds fold p out), 2,048 random int8 variants, centering only, n_threads=4, exactly 3 sweeps (tol=0) after untimed warm-ups; route on: _GEMM_MIN_SAMPLES=_GEMM_MIN_COLUMNS=1, off: _GEMM_MIN_COLUMNS=10**9; on/off alternate, 5 repetitions each
load_gate: one-minute load average below 6.5 before each timed fit (system services held it at 5.4-5.8)
rerun_note: The script is archived as run. Against a source without _GEMM_MIN_COLUMNS, its 'off' mode must raise _GEMM_MIN_SAMPLES (e.g. to 10**9) instead, or both modes take the threaded route.
